Emma L.: Hey team — new infra hire here. I enrolled my Mac mini headless into Jamf last night (macOS 13.5.1). Enrollment shows as managed, and an SSH cert/profile appears deployed, but when I SSH in and run `sudo` it rejects my password (says I'm not allowed). I also need the SSH private key for CI. Any known headless MDM quirks or who to ping?

Julia (IT): Welcome, Emma! Quick checks: is FileVault on, and does your account have SecureToken/admin rights? For headless flows we sometimes need to grant temporary admin so we can extract certs. Can you paste `fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type enrollment` outputs and the device name/serial?

Emma L.: fdesetup output:
```
FileVault is On.
Encryption in progress: No
```
profiles output:
```
Enrolled via MDM: Yes
Configuration profiles: 5
```
Device name: emmas-mini-01

mdm-bot: Device emmas-mini-01 found in Jamf (device ID: D12345). SSH cert profile `com.redwood.sshcert` was deployed 2026-02-12. Admin enrichment policy not applied. Device page: https://jamf.example.company/device/D12345

Ravi K.: Two likely causes: 1) your user isn't in the admin group / lacks SecureToken so `sudo` won't allow privilege escalation, or 2) PAM/TTY differences for non-interactive SSH sessions. Run `id -Gn` and `sudo -l` while SSH'd and paste results. For SSH certs, Jamf typically installs public keys under a managed prefs path or injects them into the user Keychain — we can locate it.

Emma L.: `id -Gn` => `staff _lpadmin`
`sudo -l` => `Sorry, user Emma L. is not allowed to run sudo on this host.`

Julia (IT): That lines up with not being an admin. We can grant a temporary expiring admin (2 hours) via an IT-approved workflow. I can approve it now if you confirm. Alternatively, SRE can push the SSH private key to your home via a secure job but that takes longer.

Emma L.: Please approve the temporary admin, that would be fastest. Also where should the SSH private key land if you export it?

ops-bot: IT ticket IT-4821 created for emmas-mini-01: temporary admin request. Link: https://helpdesk.redwood.ai/IT-4821

Julia (IT): Admin grant approved for 2 hours (ticket IT-4821). For the SSH key: Jamf's profile drops the public at `/Library/Managed Preferences/com.redwood.sshcert/ssh_identity.pub`. The helper script can export the private key into `~/.ssh/id_redwood` and run `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_redwood`. If you want to add it to your agent: `ssh-add -K ~/.ssh/id_redwood` (macOS Keychain flow). If you prefer no local key we can provision an agent cert for the CI runner instead.

Emma L.: Got it — thanks so much. I'll confirm once I'm unblocked. Really appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
